name: Large Chemical Reactor
notes: 3x3x3 of Chemically Inert Machine Casings (at least 8) around a PTFE Pipe Casing core. GT needs exactly one heating coil (any tier) in one of the face centres (top, bottom, left, right or back); it is shown in the bottom centre so all four side walls stay plain casing and can be shared. Hatches may replace any casing, including the unused face centres. GT also requires at least one input and one output of any kind. Sharing: GT5u adds every hatch it finds during the structure check to that controller's lists with no ownership check, so item and fluid buses and hatches in a shared wall serve every controller around them. Energy and maintenance hatches are not shared unless the Share options ask for it (a shared energy hatch gives each of two machines 1 A, and a shared maintenance hatch is repaired one machine at a time).
